verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its own log streaming service, which exports tenant logs in near real-time to a log analysis service, with a configurable content type and format and a payload preview in the Dashboard. That is a first-party event stream, but the evidence frames it as log export for analysis rather than a sync mechanism. Missing for 10: documented registrable HTTP webhook endpoints for programmatic consumers, explicit coverage of sign-up, sign-in and user-change event types, delivery and retry guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
